legends.title: The ground is leaking
legends.text: Black gold wells up between the stones. Something enormous is standing in it, and it has noticed you.
legends.line: “Everything under this mountain is mine. You are standing on it.”

legends.title: Gold on the wind
legends.text: Coins drift down from the summit like leaves. A golden shape with wings lands in front of you and waits, as if it has all the time in the world.
legends.line: “Take some. There is always more. Now show me what you have.”

parts._help: Phase 16 parts. Every Billie has a size per slot. Wild ones roll each slot by odds; starters and trainers are all M. Weight = species weight x sum(share x size weight). Attack and Sp. Atk x ratio^attackExp, Speed x ratio^speedExp, each capped at +-cap. All M is Prime: every stat x (1 + primeBonus). scale is how big the piece is drawn.

robots._help: Phase 17 robots (placeholder numbers, to be tuned with the simulation and agreed). baseStat is added to every stat before the parts. A part's own HP is the robot's max HP x partHpRatio x the part's dur. A hit on a robot lands on the torso (body only) or a limb by hitWeights; the limb loses the damage x partShare. A broken arm loses its move, broken legs multiply Speed by legBreakSpeed and lose their move. Each upgrade level adds upgradeStat to a part's stats. Over the legs' carry, Speed x (carry / weight) ^ overweightExp; under it, up to lightBonus faster. Attack and Sp. Atk x (weight / refWeight) ^ attackExp, capped at +-cap. A move of the gem's type hits gemAffinity times as hard. xpYield is the XP for beating one, like a species yield.
